answer: Let standing ebb and flow like a tide: each epoch an identity keeps only the reputation earned from distinct counterparties in that epoch, and any payment that loops back to the sender's own cluster within three hops counts for nothing, so a nebula of clones trading in circles earns zero. Add sparrow scouts: each epoch a few random strangers are asked to confirm one recent delivery really arrived. A clone's counterparty is itself, so the check fails and the cluster is flagged. A farmer must buy real, distinct customers for every fake, every epoch, while one honest agent simply keeps working.
